name: Doba (Hungary)
description: Three horizontal stripes of white, green and white in the ratio 1:1:1, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Doba: a quartered white, green and red shield with a church, a bunch of grapes, a castle and bars.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
